WITH 
-- Step 1: Uniformly parse all repository, merge, and timestamp variables up front
parsed_keys AS (
    SELECT
        key,
        content,
        -- Check prefix type to apply the right string slicing offset
        multiIf(
            startsWith(key, 'resolution:conflict:'),      splitByString('resolution:conflict:', key)[2],
            startsWith(key, 'evaluation:merge:core:'),    splitByString('evaluation:merge:core:', key)[2],
            startsWith(key, 'evaluation:merge:diff:'),    splitByString('evaluation:merge:diff:', key)[2],
            startsWith(key, 'evaluation:merge:schesch:'), splitByString('evaluation:merge:schesch:', key)[2],
            splitByString('evaluation:merge:classification:', key)[2]
        ) AS suffix,
        
        -- Parse into strict capturing components
        extractGroups(suffix, '(.+)\.git-([a-f0-9]{40}):(.*)$') AS groups,
        concat(groups[1], '.git') AS repo_name,
        groups[2] AS merge,
        groups[3] AS timestamp
    FROM "default"."redis_json"
    WHERE startsWith(key, 'resolution')
       OR key LIKE 'evaluation:merge:core:%'
       OR key LIKE 'evaluation:merge:diff%'
       OR key LIKE 'evaluation:merge:schesch:%'
       OR key LIKE 'evaluation:merge:classification:%'
),

-- Step 2: Extract baseline rows and processing contradictions
base_merges AS (
    SELECT
        repo_name,
        merge,
        count(*) AS total_resolutions,
        
        -- 1. Evaluates to 1 if at least one run explicitly timed out
        max(CASE WHEN content.proposed_resolution.error LIKE 'Error: opencode timed out%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) 
            AS contradiction_agent_timeout,

        -- 2. Evaluates to 1 if an error occurred, but NO runs in the group experienced a timeout
        CASE 
            WHEN max(CASE WHEN content.proposed_resolution.error LIKE 'Error: opencode timed out%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 0
            ELSE max(CASE WHEN content.proposed_resolution.error IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        END AS contradiction_agent_error
    FROM parsed_keys
    WHERE startsWith(key, 'resolution')
    GROUP BY repo_name, merge
),

-- Step 3: Compute core execution metrics and strict exact matches
core_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        repo_name AS core_repo,
        merge AS core_merge,
        COUNT(DISTINCT key) AS total_evaluations,
        
        -- Flag: 1 if ALL evaluations within the group are complete
        min(CASE WHEN key != '' AND content.incomplete_merge = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS contradiction_is_incomplete_merge,

        -- Proof Flag: 1 only if EVERY evaluation achieved a strict perfect match
        min(CASE WHEN key != '' AND content.perfect_match != 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS proof_is_exact_match
    FROM parsed_keys
    WHERE key LIKE 'evaluation:merge:core:%'
    GROUP BY core_repo, core_merge
),

-- Step 4: Compute whitespace-normalized exact match text diffs
diff_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        repo_name AS diff_repo,
        merge AS diff_merge,
        
        -- Proof Flag: 1 only if EVERY evaluation matches exactly when normalizing for whitespace and blanks
        min(CASE WHEN content.proposed_to_actual_resolution_diffs.ignore_all_space.ignore_blank_lines.exact_match::boolean THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS proof_is_exact_match_normalized
    FROM parsed_keys
    WHERE key LIKE 'evaluation:merge:diff%'
    GROUP BY diff_repo, diff_merge
),

-- Step 5: Compute Schesch runtime compilation and test execution metrics
schesch_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        repo_name AS schesch_repo,
        merge AS schesch_merge,
        
        -- Flag: 1 if ANY run had a compilation failure on the proposed side (where human side succeeded)
        max(CASE WHEN content.human.compilation_failed = false 
                  AND content.human.test_execution_failed = false 
                  AND content.human.timed_out = false 
                  AND content.proposed.timed_out = false
                  AND content.proposed.compilation_failed::boolean THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS contradiction_proposed_compilation_failed,
                  
        -- Flag: 1 if ANY run had a test failure on the proposed side (where human side succeeded)
        max(CASE WHEN content.human.compilation_failed = false 
                  AND content.human.test_execution_failed = false 
                  AND content.human.timed_out = false 
                  AND content.proposed.timed_out = false
                  AND content.proposed.test_execution_failed::boolean THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS contradiction_proposed_test_failed
    FROM parsed_keys
    WHERE key LIKE 'evaluation:merge:schesch:%'
    GROUP BY schesch_repo, schesch_merge
),

-- Step 6: Process conflict classification arrays and aggregate structural failure flags
classification_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        repo_name AS class_repo,
        merge AS class_merge,
        
        MAX(agentClassification NOT LIKE '%CONTEXT_CHANGED%' AND humanClassification NOT LIKE '%CONTEXT_CHANGED%' AND canonical_diff_exists) AS contradiction_canonical_resolution_differs,
        MAX(agentClassification NOT LIKE '%CONTEXT_CHANGED%' AND humanClassification NOT LIKE '%CONTEXT_CHANGED%' AND contradiction_exists) AS contradiction_semicanonical_contradiction,
        MAX(agentClassification NOT LIKE '%CONTEXT_CHANGED%' AND humanClassification NOT LIKE '%CONTEXT_CHANGED%' AND dilution_exists) AS contradiction_semicanonical_dilution,
        MAX(agentClassification NOT LIKE '%CONTEXT_CHANGED%' AND humanClassification NOT LIKE '%CONTEXT_CHANGED%' AND ghost_exists) AS contradiction_ghost_resolution,
        MAX(agentClassification NOT LIKE '%CONTEXT_CHANGED%' AND humanClassification NOT LIKE '%CONTEXT_CHANGED%' AND fallback_exists) AS contradiction_noncanonical_fallback
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            repo_name, merge,
            arrayStringConcat(logical_conflict.agent_classifications, '\n') AS agentClassification,
            arrayStringConcat(logical_conflict.human_classifications, '\n') AS humanClassification,
            
            CAST(
                arrayZip(logical_conflict.agent_classifications, logical_conflict.human_classifications), 
                'Array(Tuple(String, String))'
            ) AS zipped,

            arrayExists(t -> (
                t.1 IN ('CHUNK_CANONICAL_OURS', 'CHUNK_CANONICAL_THEIRS', 'CHUNK_CANONICAL_BASE') AND
                t.2 IN ('CHUNK_CANONICAL_OURS', 'CHUNK_CANONICAL_THEIRS', 'CHUNK_CANONICAL_BASE') AND t.1 != t.2
            ), zipped) AS canonical_diff_exists,
            
            arrayExists(t -> (
                (t.1 = 'CHUNK_CANONICAL_OURS'   AND t.2 = 'CHUNK_SEMICANONICAL_BASETHEIRS') OR
                (t.2 = 'CHUNK_CANONICAL_OURS'   AND t.1 = 'CHUNK_SEMICANONICAL_BASETHEIRS') OR
                (t.1 = 'CHUNK_CANONICAL_THEIRS' AND t.2 = 'CHUNK_SEMICANONICAL_OURSBASE')   OR
                (t.2 = 'CHUNK_CANONICAL_THEIRS' AND t.1 = 'CHUNK_SEMICANONICAL_OURSBASE')   OR
                (t.1 = 'CHUNK_CANONICAL_BASE'   AND t.2 = 'CHUNK_SEMICANONICAL_OURSTHEIRS') OR
                (t.2 = 'CHUNK_CANONICAL_BASE'   AND t.1 = 'CHUNK_SEMICANONICAL_OURSTHEIRS')
            ), zipped) AS contradiction_exists,
            
            arrayExists(t -> (
                (t.1 LIKE 'CHUNK_SEMICANONICAL_%' AND t.1 != 'CHUNK_SEMICANONICAL_OURSBASETHEIRS' AND t.2 = 'CHUNK_SEMICANONICAL_OURSBASETHEIRS') OR
                (t.2 LIKE 'CHUNK_SEMICANONICAL_%' AND t.2 != 'CHUNK_SEMICANONICAL_OURSBASETHEIRS' AND t.1 = 'CHUNK_SEMICANONICAL_OURSBASETHEIRS')
            ), zipped) AS dilution_exists,
            
            arrayExists(t -> (t.1 LIKE 'CHUNK_%CANONICAL%' AND t.1 != 'CHUNK_SEMICANONICAL_EMPTY' AND t.2 = 'CHUNK_SEMICANONICAL_EMPTY'), zipped) AS ghost_exists,
            arrayExists(t -> (t.1 LIKE 'CHUNK_%CANONICAL%' AND t.1 != 'CHUNK_NONCANONICAL' AND t.2 = 'CHUNK_NONCANONICAL'), zipped) AS fallback_exists
        FROM parsed_keys
        ARRAY JOIN content.logical_conflicts::Array(JSON) AS logical_conflict
        WHERE key LIKE 'evaluation:merge:classification:%'
    )
    GROUP BY class_repo, class_merge
),

-- Step 7: Reduce row flags to a singular, prioritized enum string per group (Repo + Merge match)
classified_groups AS (
    SELECT
        CASE 
            WHEN coalesce(m.proof_is_exact_match, 0) = 1            THEN 'PROOF_IS_EXACT_MATCH'
            WHEN coalesce(d.proof_is_exact_match_normalized, 0) = 1 THEN 'PROOF_IS_EXACT_MATCH_NORMALIZED'
            
            WHEN coalesce(b.contradiction_agent_error, 0) = 1   THEN 'CONTRADICTION_AGENT_ERROR'
            WHEN coalesce(b.contradiction_agent_timeout, 0) = 1   THEN 'CONTRADICTION_AGENT_TIMEOUT'
            WHEN coalesce(m.contradiction_is_incomplete_merge, 0) = 1         THEN 'CONTRADICTION_IS_INCOMPLETE_MERGE'
            WHEN coalesce(s.contradiction_proposed_compilation_failed, 0) = 1 THEN 'CONTRADICTION_PROPOSED_COMPILATION_FAILED'
            WHEN coalesce(s.contradiction_proposed_test_failed, 0) = 1        THEN 'CONTRADICTION_PROPOSED_TEST_FAILED'
            
            WHEN coalesce(c.contradiction_canonical_resolution_differs, 0) = 1 THEN 'CONTRADICTION_CANONICAL_RESOLUTION_DIFFERS'
            WHEN coalesce(c.contradiction_semicanonical_contradiction, 0) = 1   THEN 'CONTRADICTION_SEMICANONICAL_CONTRADICTION'
            WHEN coalesce(c.contradiction_semicanonical_dilution, 0) = 1        THEN 'CONTRADICTION_SEMICANONICAL_DILUTION'
            WHEN coalesce(c.contradiction_ghost_resolution, 0) = 1              THEN 'CONTRADICTION_GHOST_RESOLUTION'
            WHEN coalesce(c.contradiction_noncanonical_fallback, 0) = 1         THEN 'CONTRADICTION_NONCANONICAL_FALLBACK'
            
            ELSE 'UNCLASSIFIED_DIVERGENCE'
        END AS resolution_status
    FROM base_merges b
    LEFT JOIN core_metrics m ON m.core_repo = b.repo_name AND m.core_merge = b.merge
    LEFT JOIN diff_metrics d ON d.diff_repo = b.repo_name AND d.diff_merge = b.merge
    LEFT JOIN schesch_metrics s ON s.schesch_repo = b.repo_name AND s.schesch_merge = b.merge
    LEFT JOIN classification_metrics c ON c.class_repo = b.repo_name AND c.class_merge = b.merge
)

-- Step 8: Calculate final proportional ratio breakdowns out of 100%
SELECT
    'All' AS label,
    
    countIf(resolution_status = 'PROOF_IS_EXACT_MATCH') / count(*)            AS proof_is_exact_match,
    countIf(resolution_status = 'PROOF_IS_EXACT_MATCH_NORMALIZED') / count(*) AS proof_is_exact_match_normalized,

    countIf(resolution_status = 'UNCLASSIFIED_DIVERGENCE') / count(*)         AS unclassified_divergences,
    
    countIf(resolution_status = 'CONTRADICTION_NONCANONICAL_FALLBACK') / count(*)         AS contradiction_noncanonical_fallback,
    countIf(resolution_status = 'CONTRADICTION_GHOST_RESOLUTION') / count(*)              AS contradiction_ghost_resolution,
    countIf(resolution_status = 'CONTRADICTION_SEMICANONICAL_DILUTION') / count(*)        AS contradiction_semicanonical_dilution,
    countIf(resolution_status = 'CONTRADICTION_SEMICANONICAL_CONTRADICTION') / count(*)   AS contradiction_semicanonical_contradiction,
    countIf(resolution_status = 'CONTRADICTION_CANONICAL_RESOLUTION_DIFFERS') / count(*) AS contradiction_canonical_resolution_differs,
    countIf(resolution_status = 'CONTRADICTION_PROPOSED_TEST_FAILED') / count(*)        AS contradiction_proposed_test_failed,
    countIf(resolution_status = 'CONTRADICTION_PROPOSED_COMPILATION_FAILED') / count(*) AS contradiction_proposed_compilation_failed,
    countIf(resolution_status = 'CONTRADICTION_IS_INCOMPLETE_MERGE') / count(*)         AS contradiction_is_incomplete_merge,
    countIf(resolution_status = 'CONTRADICTION_AGENT_TIMEOUT') / count(*)                 AS contradiction_agent_timeout,
    countIf(resolution_status = 'CONTRADICTION_AGENT_ERROR') / count(*)                   AS contradiction_agent_error
FROM classified_groups;

with
  base as (
    SELECT
      arrayElement (splitByString ('resolution:conflict:', key), 2) as resolution,
      extractGroups (
        arrayElement (splitByString ('resolution:conflict:', key), 2),
        '(.+)\.git-([a-f0-9]{40}):(.*)$'
      ) AS groups,
      content.proposed_resolution.error
    FROM
      "default"."redis_json"
    where
      startsWith (key, 'resolution')
      and content.proposed_resolution.error is not null
    order by
      content.resolution_end::datetime desc
  )
SELECT
  concat(groups[1], '.git') AS repo_name,
  groups[2] AS merge,
  groups[3] AS timestamp,
  content.proposed_resolution.error,
  'Show Details' as details
from
  base;

WITH base AS (
    SELECT 
        key,
        logical_conflict.logical_conflict_index AS conflict_index,
        arrayStringConcat(logical_conflict.agent_classifications, '\n') AS agentClassification,
        arrayStringConcat(logical_conflict.human_classifications, '\n') AS humanClassification,
        
        -- Secure array mapping out of Dynamic JSON tracking
        CAST(
            arrayZip(logical_conflict.agent_classifications, logical_conflict.human_classifications),
            'Array(Tuple(String, String))'
        ) AS zipped_classifications
    FROM "default"."redis_json"
    ARRAY JOIN content.logical_conflicts::Array(JSON) AS logical_conflict
    WHERE key LIKE 'evaluation:merge:classification:%'
)
SELECT
    key,
    
    -- Mode 0: Original check (Canonical mismatch)
    max(
        agentClassification NOT LIKE '%CONTEXT_CHANGED%' AND 
        humanClassification NOT LIKE '%CONTEXT_CHANGED%' AND
        arrayExists(t -> (
            t.1 IN ('CHUNK_CANONICAL_OURS', 'CHUNK_CANONICAL_THEIRS', 'CHUNK_CANONICAL_BASE') AND
            t.2 IN ('CHUNK_CANONICAL_OURS', 'CHUNK_CANONICAL_THEIRS', 'CHUNK_CANONICAL_BASE') AND
            t.1 != t.2
        ), zipped_classifications)
    ) AS canonical_contradiction,

    -- Mode 1: Canonical vs Semicanonical Contradiction (e.g., One picked OURS, other dropped it for BASE/THEIRS)
    max(
        agentClassification NOT LIKE '%CONTEXT_CHANGED%' AND 
        humanClassification NOT LIKE '%CONTEXT_CHANGED%' AND
        arrayExists(t -> (
            (t.1 = 'CHUNK_CANONICAL_OURS'   AND t.2 = 'CHUNK_SEMICANONICAL_BASETHEIRS') OR
            (t.2 = 'CHUNK_CANONICAL_OURS'   AND t.1 = 'CHUNK_SEMICANONICAL_BASETHEIRS') OR
            (t.1 = 'CHUNK_CANONICAL_THEIRS' AND t.2 = 'CHUNK_SEMICANONICAL_OURSBASE')   OR
            (t.2 = 'CHUNK_CANONICAL_THEIRS' AND t.1 = 'CHUNK_SEMICANONICAL_OURSBASE')   OR
            (t.1 = 'CHUNK_CANONICAL_BASE'   AND t.2 = 'CHUNK_SEMICANONICAL_OURSTHEIRS') OR
            (t.2 = 'CHUNK_CANONICAL_BASE'   AND t.1 = 'CHUNK_SEMICANONICAL_OURSTHEIRS')
        ), zipped_classifications)
    ) AS semicanonical_contradiction,

    -- Mode 3: Asymmetric Ghost Resolutions (One kept history, one completely emptied logic)
    max(
        agentClassification NOT LIKE '%CONTEXT_CHANGED%' AND 
        humanClassification NOT LIKE '%CONTEXT_CHANGED%' AND
        arrayExists(t -> (
            (t.1 LIKE 'CHUNK_%CANONICAL%' AND t.2 = 'CHUNK_SEMICANONICAL_EMPTY') or
            (t.2 LIKE 'CHUNK_%CANONICAL%' AND t.1 = 'CHUNK_SEMICANONICAL_EMPTY')
        ), zipped_classifications)
    ) AS ghost_resolution,

    -- Mode 4: Heuristic Fallback Breakdown (The agent resolved structurally, human resorted to raw text)
    max(
        agentClassification NOT LIKE '%CONTEXT_CHANGED%' AND 
        humanClassification NOT LIKE '%CONTEXT_CHANGED%' AND
        arrayExists(t -> (
            (t.1 LIKE 'CHUNK_%CANONICAL%' AND t.2 = 'CHUNK_NONCANONICAL')
        ), zipped_classifications)
    ) AS missed_noncanonical_necessity

FROM base
GROUP BY key
ORDER BY 
    canonical_contradiction DESC, 
    semicanonical_contradiction DESC, 
    ghost_resolution DESC, 
    missed_noncanonical_necessity DESC

with base as (
    SELECT * FROM "default"."redis_json"
    where startsWith(key, 'evaluation:merge:schesch')
    and content.human.compilation_failed = false
    and content.human.test_execution_failed = false
    and content.human.timed_out = false
    and content.proposed.timed_out = false
)
select
    sum(case when content.proposed.compilation_failed::boolean then 1 else 0 end)/count(*) as compilation_failures,
    sum(case when content.proposed.test_execution_failed::boolean then 1 else 0 end)/count(*) as test_failures
from base

SELECT 
    outer_pair.1 AS match_type,
    -- 3. The ratio (exact_matches / total) expressed as a decimal between 0.0 and 1.0
    avg(JSONExtractString(inner_pair.2, 'exact_match') = 'true') AS exact_match_ratio
FROM "default"."redis_json"
-- 1. Parse the target object straight into a ClickHouse Map (String -> String)
ARRAY JOIN JSONExtract(
    JSONExtractRaw(content, 'proposed_to_actual_resolution_diffs'), 
    'Map(String, String)'
) AS outer_pair
-- 2. Take the value of the outer map (which is the inner JSON) and explode its pairs

where inner_pair.1 = 'include_blank_lines'
GROUP BY 
    outer_pair.1
order by exact_match_ratio

SELECT 
    outer_pair.1 AS match_type,
    countIf(JSONExtractString(inner_pair.2, 'exact_match') = 'true') AS exact_match_count
FROM "default"."redis_json"
-- 1. Parse the target object straight into a ClickHouse Map (String -> String)
ARRAY JOIN JSONExtract(
    JSONExtractRaw(content, 'proposed_to_actual_resolution_diffs'), 
    'Map(String, String)'
) AS outer_pair
-- 2. Take the value of the outer map (which is the inner JSON) and explode its pairs
ARRAY JOIN JSONExtractKeysAndValuesRaw(outer_pair.2) AS inner_pair
where inner_pair.1 = 'ignore_blank_lines'

order by exact_match_count

        merge AS class_merge,
        timestamp,
        
        MAX(agentClassification NOT LIKE '%CONTEXT_CHANGED%' AND humanClassification NOT LIKE '%CONTEXT_CHANGED%' AND canonical_diff_exists) AS contradiction_canonical_resolution_differs,
        MAX(agentClassification NOT LIKE '%CONTEXT_CHANGED%' AND humanClassification NOT LIKE '%CONTEXT_CHANGED%' AND contradiction_exists) AS contradiction_semicanonical_contradiction,
        MAX(agentClassification NOT LIKE '%CONTEXT_CHANGED%' AND humanClassification NOT LIKE '%CONTEXT_CHANGED%' AND dilution_exists) AS contradiction_semicanonical_dilution,
        MAX(agentClassification NOT LIKE '%CONTEXT_CHANGED%' AND humanClassification NOT LIKE '%CONTEXT_CHANGED%' AND ghost_exists) AS contradiction_ghost_resolution,
        MAX(agentClassification NOT LIKE '%CONTEXT_CHANGED%' AND humanClassification NOT LIKE '%CONTEXT_CHANGED%' AND fallback_exists) AS contradiction_noncanonical_fallback
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            repo_name, merge, timestamp,
            arrayStringConcat(logical_conflict.agent_classifications, '\n') AS agentClassification,
            arrayStringConcat(logical_conflict.human_classifications, '\n') AS humanClassification,
            
            CAST(
                arrayZip(logical_conflict.agent_classifications, logical_conflict.human_classifications), 
                'Array(Tuple(String, String))'
            ) AS zipped,

            arrayExists(t -> (
                t.1 IN ('CHUNK_CANONICAL_OURS', 'CHUNK_CANONICAL_THEIRS', 'CHUNK_CANONICAL_BASE') AND
                t.2 IN ('CHUNK_CANONICAL_OURS', 'CHUNK_CANONICAL_THEIRS', 'CHUNK_CANONICAL_BASE') AND t.1 != t.2
            ), zipped) AS canonical_diff_exists,
            
            arrayExists(t -> (
                (t.1 = 'CHUNK_CANONICAL_OURS'   AND t.2 = 'CHUNK_SEMICANONICAL_BASETHEIRS') OR
                (t.2 = 'CHUNK_CANONICAL_OURS'   AND t.1 = 'CHUNK_SEMICANONICAL_BASETHEIRS') OR
                (t.1 = 'CHUNK_CANONICAL_THEIRS' AND t.2 = 'CHUNK_SEMICANONICAL_OURSBASE')   OR
                (t.2 = 'CHUNK_CANONICAL_THEIRS' AND t.1 = 'CHUNK_SEMICANONICAL_OURSBASE')   OR
                (t.1 = 'CHUNK_CANONICAL_BASE'   AND t.2 = 'CHUNK_SEMICANONICAL_OURSTHEIRS') OR
                (t.2 = 'CHUNK_CANONICAL_BASE'   AND t.1 = 'CHUNK_SEMICANONICAL_OURSTHEIRS')
            ), zipped) AS contradiction_exists,
            
            arrayExists(t -> (
                (t.1 LIKE 'CHUNK_SEMICANONICAL_%' AND t.1 != 'CHUNK_SEMICANONICAL_OURSBASETHEIRS' AND t.2 = 'CHUNK_SEMICANONICAL_OURSBASETHEIRS') OR
                (t.2 LIKE 'CHUNK_SEMICANONICAL_%' AND t.2 != 'CHUNK_SEMICANONICAL_OURSBASETHEIRS' AND t.1 = 'CHUNK_SEMICANONICAL_OURSBASETHEIRS')
            ), zipped) AS dilution_exists,
            
            arrayExists(t -> (t.1 LIKE 'CHUNK_%CANONICAL%' AND t.1 != 'CHUNK_SEMICANONICAL_EMPTY' AND t.2 = 'CHUNK_SEMICANONICAL_EMPTY'), zipped) AS ghost_exists,
            arrayExists(t -> (t.1 LIKE 'CHUNK_%CANONICAL%' AND t.1 != 'CHUNK_NONCANONICAL' AND t.2 = 'CHUNK_NONCANONICAL'), zipped) AS fallback_exists
        FROM parsed_keys
        ARRAY JOIN content.logical_conflicts::Array(JSON) AS logical_conflict
        WHERE key LIKE 'evaluation:merge:classification:%'
    )
    GROUP BY class_repo, class_merge, timestamp
),

-- Step 7: Reduce row flags to a singular, prioritized enum string per group (Repo + Merge match)
classified_groups AS (
    SELECT
        CASE 
            WHEN coalesce(m.proof_is_exact_match, 0) = 1            THEN 'PROOF_IS_EXACT_MATCH'
            WHEN coalesce(d.proof_is_exact_match_normalized, 0) = 1 THEN 'PROOF_IS_EXACT_MATCH_NORMALIZED'
            
            WHEN coalesce(b.contradiction_agent_error, 0) = 1   THEN 'CONTRADICTION_AGENT_ERROR'
            WHEN coalesce(b.contradiction_agent_timeout, 0) = 1   THEN 'CONTRADICTION_AGENT_TIMEOUT'
            WHEN coalesce(m.contradiction_is_incomplete_merge, 0) = 1         THEN 'CONTRADICTION_IS_INCOMPLETE_MERGE'
            WHEN coalesce(s.contradiction_proposed_compilation_failed, 0) = 1 THEN 'CONTRADICTION_PROPOSED_COMPILATION_FAILED'
            WHEN coalesce(s.contradiction_proposed_test_failed, 0) = 1        THEN 'CONTRADICTION_PROPOSED_TEST_FAILED'
            
            WHEN coalesce(c.contradiction_canonical_resolution_differs, 0) = 1 THEN 'CONTRADICTION_CANONICAL_RESOLUTION_DIFFERS'
            WHEN coalesce(c.contradiction_semicanonical_contradiction, 0) = 1   THEN 'CONTRADICTION_SEMICANONICAL_CONTRADICTION'
            WHEN coalesce(c.contradiction_semicanonical_dilution, 0) = 1        THEN 'CONTRADICTION_SEMICANONICAL_DILUTION'
            WHEN coalesce(c.contradiction_ghost_resolution, 0) = 1              THEN 'CONTRADICTION_GHOST_RESOLUTION'
            WHEN coalesce(c.contradiction_noncanonical_fallback, 0) = 1         THEN 'CONTRADICTION_NONCANONICAL_FALLBACK'
            
            ELSE 'UNCLASSIFIED_DIVERGENCE'
        END AS resolution_status
    FROM base_merges b
    LEFT JOIN core_metrics m ON m.core_repo = b.repo_name AND m.core_merge = b.merge AND m.timestamp = b.timestamp
    LEFT JOIN diff_metrics d ON d.diff_repo = b.repo_name AND d.diff_merge = b.merge AND d.timestamp = b.timestamp
    LEFT JOIN schesch_metrics s ON s.schesch_repo = b.repo_name AND s.schesch_merge = b.merge AND s.timestamp = b.timestamp
    LEFT JOIN classification_metrics c ON c.class_repo = b.repo_name AND c.class_merge = b.merge AND c.timestamp = b.timestamp
)

-- Step 8: Calculate final proportional ratio breakdowns out of 100%
SELECT
    'All' AS label,
    
    countIf(resolution_status = 'PROOF_IS_EXACT_MATCH') / count(*)            AS proof_is_exact_match,
    countIf(resolution_status = 'PROOF_IS_EXACT_MATCH_NORMALIZED') / count(*) AS proof_is_exact_match_normalized,

    countIf(resolution_status = 'UNCLASSIFIED_DIVERGENCE') / count(*)         AS unclassified_divergences,
    
    countIf(resolution_status = 'CONTRADICTION_NONCANONICAL_FALLBACK') / count(*)         AS contradiction_noncanonical_fallback,
    countIf(resolution_status = 'CONTRADICTION_GHOST_RESOLUTION') / count(*)              AS contradiction_ghost_resolution,
    countIf(resolution_status = 'CONTRADICTION_SEMICANONICAL_DILUTION') / count(*)        AS contradiction_semicanonical_dilution,
    countIf(resolution_status = 'CONTRADICTION_SEMICANONICAL_CONTRADICTION') / count(*)   AS contradiction_semicanonical_contradiction,
    countIf(resolution_status = 'CONTRADICTION_CANONICAL_RESOLUTION_DIFFERS') / count(*) AS contradiction_canonical_resolution_differs,
    countIf(resolution_status = 'CONTRADICTION_PROPOSED_TEST_FAILED') / count(*)        AS contradiction_proposed_test_failed,
    countIf(resolution_status = 'CONTRADICTION_PROPOSED_COMPILATION_FAILED') / count(*) AS contradiction_proposed_compilation_failed,
    countIf(resolution_status = 'CONTRADICTION_IS_INCOMPLETE_MERGE') / count(*)         AS contradiction_is_incomplete_merge,
    countIf(resolution_status = 'CONTRADICTION_AGENT_TIMEOUT') / count(*)                 AS contradiction_agent_timeout,
    countIf(resolution_status = 'CONTRADICTION_AGENT_ERROR') / count(*)                   AS contradiction_agent_error
FROM classified_groups;
SELECT sum(case when content.proposed_resolution.error is not null then 1 else 0 end)/count(*) FROM "default"."redis_json" where startsWith(key, 'resolution')

WITH 
-- Step 1: Uniformly parse all repository, merge, and timestamp variables up front
parsed_keys AS (
    SELECT
        key,
        content,
        -- Check prefix type to apply the right string slicing offset
        multiIf(
            startsWith(key, 'resolution:conflict:'),      splitByString('resolution:conflict:', key)[2],
            startsWith(key, 'evaluation:merge:core:'),    splitByString('evaluation:merge:core:', key)[2],
            startsWith(key, 'evaluation:merge:diff:'),    splitByString('evaluation:merge:diff:', key)[2],
            startsWith(key, 'evaluation:merge:schesch:'), splitByString('evaluation:merge:schesch:', key)[2],
            splitByString('evaluation:merge:classification:', key)[2]
        ) AS suffix,
        
        -- Parse into strict capturing components
        extractGroups(suffix, '(.+)\.git-([a-f0-9]{40}):(.*)$') AS groups,
        concat(groups[1], '.git') AS repo_name,
        groups[2] AS merge,
        groups[3] AS timestamp
    FROM "default"."redis_json"
    WHERE startsWith(key, 'resolution')
       OR key LIKE 'evaluation:merge:core:%'
       OR key LIKE 'evaluation:merge:diff%'
       OR key LIKE 'evaluation:merge:schesch:%'
       OR key LIKE 'evaluation:merge:classification:%'
),

-- Step 2: Extract baseline rows and processing contradictions
base_merges AS (
    SELECT
        repo_name,
        merge,
        count(*) AS total_resolutions,
        max(timestamp) AS timestamp,  -- Tracking target reference point
        
        -- Flag: 1 if at least one run explicitly timed out
        max(CASE WHEN content.proposed_resolution.error LIKE 'Error: opencode timed out%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) 
            AS contradiction_agent_timeout,

        -- Flag: 1 if an error occurred, but NO runs in the group experienced a timeout
        CASE 
            WHEN max(CASE WHEN content.proposed_resolution.error LIKE 'Error: opencode timed out%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 0
            ELSE max(CASE WHEN content.proposed_resolution.error IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        END AS contradiction_agent_error
    FROM parsed_keys
    WHERE startsWith(key, 'resolution')
    GROUP BY repo_name, merge
),

-- Step 3: Compute core execution metrics and strict exact matches
core_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        repo_name AS core_repo,
        merge AS core_merge,
        COUNT(DISTINCT key) AS total_evaluations,
        
        -- Flag: 1 if ALL evaluations within the group are complete
        min(CASE WHEN key != '' AND content.incomplete_merge = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS contradiction_is_incomplete_merge,

        -- Proof Flag: 1 only if EVERY evaluation achieved a strict perfect match
        min(CASE WHEN key != '' AND content.perfect_match != 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS proof_is_exact_match
    FROM parsed_keys
    WHERE key LIKE 'evaluation:merge:core:%'
    GROUP BY core_repo, core_merge
),

-- Step 4: Compute whitespace-normalized exact match text diffs
diff_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        repo_name AS diff_repo,
        merge AS diff_merge,
        
        -- Proof Flag: 1 only if EVERY evaluation matches exactly when normalizing for whitespace and blanks
        min(CASE WHEN content.proposed_to_actual_resolution_diffs.ignore_all_space.ignore_blank_lines.exact_match::boolean THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS proof_is_exact_match_normalized
    FROM parsed_keys
    WHERE key LIKE 'evaluation:merge:diff%'
    GROUP BY diff_repo, diff_merge
),

-- Step 5: Compute Schesch runtime compilation and test execution metrics
schesch_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        repo_name AS schesch_repo,
        merge AS schesch_merge,
        
        -- Flag: 1 if ANY run had a compilation failure on the proposed side (where human side succeeded)
        max(CASE WHEN content.human.compilation_failed = false 
                  AND content.human.test_execution_failed = false 
                  AND content.human.timed_out = false 
                  AND content.proposed.timed_out = false
                  AND content.proposed.compilation_failed::boolean THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS contradiction_proposed_compilation_failed,
                  
        -- Flag: 1 if ANY run had a test failure on the proposed side (where human side succeeded)
        max(CASE WHEN content.human.compilation_failed = false 
                  AND content.human.test_execution_failed = false 
                  AND content.human.timed_out = false 
                  AND content.proposed.timed_out = false
                  AND content.proposed.test_execution_failed::boolean THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS contradiction_proposed_test_failed
    FROM parsed_keys
    WHERE key LIKE 'evaluation:merge:schesch:%'
    GROUP BY schesch_repo, schesch_merge
),

-- Step 6: Process conflict classification arrays and aggregate structural failure flags
classification_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        repo_name AS class_repo,
        merge AS class_merge,
        
        MAX(agentClassification NOT LIKE '%CONTEXT_CHANGED%' AND humanClassification NOT LIKE '%CONTEXT_CHANGED%' AND canonical_diff_exists) AS contradiction_canonical_resolution_differs,
        MAX(agentClassification NOT LIKE '%CONTEXT_CHANGED%' AND humanClassification NOT LIKE '%CONTEXT_CHANGED%' AND contradiction_exists) AS contradiction_semicanonical_contradiction,
        MAX(agentClassification NOT LIKE '%CONTEXT_CHANGED%' AND humanClassification NOT LIKE '%CONTEXT_CHANGED%' AND dilution_exists) AS contradiction_semicanonical_dilution,
        MAX(agentClassification NOT LIKE '%CONTEXT_CHANGED%' AND humanClassification NOT LIKE '%CONTEXT_CHANGED%' AND ghost_exists) AS contradiction_ghost_resolution,
        MAX(agentClassification NOT LIKE '%CONTEXT_CHANGED%' AND humanClassification NOT LIKE '%CONTEXT_CHANGED%' AND fallback_exists) AS contradiction_noncanonical_fallback
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            repo_name, merge,
            arrayStringConcat(logical_conflict.agent_classifications, '\n') AS agentClassification,
            arrayStringConcat(logical_conflict.human_classifications, '\n') AS humanClassification,
            
            CAST(
                arrayZip(logical_conflict.agent_classifications, logical_conflict.human_classifications), 
                'Array(Tuple(String, String))'
            ) AS zipped,

            arrayExists(t -> (
                t.1 IN ('CHUNK_CANONICAL_OURS', 'CHUNK_CANONICAL_THEIRS', 'CHUNK_CANONICAL_BASE') AND
                t.2 IN ('CHUNK_CANONICAL_OURS', 'CHUNK_CANONICAL_THEIRS', 'CHUNK_CANONICAL_BASE') AND t.1 != t.2
            ), zipped) AS canonical_diff_exists,
            
            arrayExists(t -> (
                (t.1 = 'CHUNK_CANONICAL_OURS'   AND t.2 = 'CHUNK_SEMICANONICAL_BASETHEIRS') OR
                (t.2 = 'CHUNK_CANONICAL_OURS'   AND t.1 = 'CHUNK_SEMICANONICAL_BASETHEIRS') OR
                (t.1 = 'CHUNK_CANONICAL_THEIRS' AND t.2 = 'CHUNK_SEMICANONICAL_OURSBASE')   OR
                (t.2 = 'CHUNK_CANONICAL_THEIRS' AND t.1 = 'CHUNK_SEMICANONICAL_OURSBASE')   OR
                (t.1 = 'CHUNK_CANONICAL_BASE'   AND t.2 = 'CHUNK_SEMICANONICAL_OURSTHEIRS') OR
                (t.2 = 'CHUNK_CANONICAL_BASE'   AND t.1 = 'CHUNK_SEMICANONICAL_OURSTHEIRS')
            ), zipped) AS contradiction_exists,
            
            arrayExists(t -> (
                (t.1 LIKE 'CHUNK_SEMICANONICAL_%' AND t.1 != 'CHUNK_SEMICANONICAL_OURSBASETHEIRS' AND t.2 = 'CHUNK_SEMICANONICAL_OURSBASETHEIRS') OR
                (t.2 LIKE 'CHUNK_SEMICANONICAL_%' AND t.2 != 'CHUNK_SEMICANONICAL_OURSBASETHEIRS' AND t.1 = 'CHUNK_SEMICANONICAL_OURSBASETHEIRS')
            ), zipped) AS dilution_exists,
            
            arrayExists(t -> (t.1 LIKE 'CHUNK_%CANONICAL%' AND t.1 != 'CHUNK_SEMICANONICAL_EMPTY' AND t.2 = 'CHUNK_SEMICANONICAL_EMPTY'), zipped) AS ghost_exists,
            arrayExists(t -> (t.1 LIKE 'CHUNK_%CANONICAL%' AND t.1 != 'CHUNK_NONCANONICAL' AND t.2 = 'CHUNK_NONCANONICAL'), zipped) AS fallback_exists
        FROM parsed_keys
        ARRAY JOIN content.logical_conflicts::Array(JSON) AS logical_conflict
        WHERE key LIKE 'evaluation:merge:classification:%'
    )
    GROUP BY class_repo, class_merge
)

-- Step 7: Final assembly tracking your precise requested sequential columns layout
SELECT
    b.repo_name,
    b.merge,
    b.timestamp,
    b.total_resolutions,
    coalesce(m.total_evaluations, 0) AS total_evaluations,
    'Show Details' AS details,
    
    -- Proof Metrics Group
    coalesce(m.proof_is_exact_match, 0)            AS proof_is_exact_match,
    coalesce(d.proof_is_exact_match_normalized, 0) AS proof_is_exact_match_normalized,
    
    -- Contradiction Metrics Group
    coalesce(b.contradiction_agent_error, 0)                  AS contradiction_agent_error,
    coalesce(b.contradiction_agent_timeout, 0)                AS contradiction_agent_timeout,
    coalesce(m.contradiction_is_incomplete_merge, 0)          AS contradiction_is_incomplete_merge,
    coalesce(s.contradiction_proposed_compilation_failed, 0)  AS contradiction_proposed_compilation_failed,
    coalesce(s.contradiction_proposed_test_failed, 0)         AS contradiction_proposed_test_failed,
    coalesce(c.contradiction_canonical_resolution_differs, 0) AS contradiction_canonical_resolution_differs,
    coalesce(c.contradiction_semicanonical_contradiction, 0)   AS contradiction_semicanonical_contradiction,
    coalesce(c.contradiction_semicanonical_dilution, 0)        AS contradiction_semicanonical_dilution,
    coalesce(c.contradiction_ghost_resolution, 0)              AS contradiction_ghost_resolution,
    coalesce(c.contradiction_noncanonical_fallback, 0)         AS contradiction_noncanonical_fallback

FROM base_merges b
LEFT JOIN core_metrics m 
    ON m.core_repo = b.repo_name AND m.core_merge = b.merge
LEFT JOIN diff_metrics d
    ON d.diff_repo = b.repo_name AND d.diff_merge = b.merge
LEFT JOIN schesch_metrics s
    ON s.schesch_repo = b.repo_name AND s.schesch_merge = b.merge
LEFT JOIN classification_metrics c 
    ON c.class_repo = b.repo_name AND c.class_merge = b.merge
ORDER BY 
    proof_is_exact_match DESC,
    proof_is_exact_match_normalized DESC,
    contradiction_agent_error DESC,
    contradiction_agent_timeout DESC,
    contradiction_is_incomplete_merge DESC,
    contradiction_proposed_compilation_failed DESC,
    contradiction_proposed_test_failed DESC,
    contradiction_canonical_resolution_differs DESC,
    contradiction_semicanonical_contradiction DESC,
    contradiction_semicanonical_dilution DESC,
    contradiction_ghost_resolution DESC,
    contradiction_noncanonical_fallback DESC;

WITH base_merges AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        concat(groups[1], '.git') AS repo_name,
        groups[2] AS merge
    FROM (
        SELECT
            extractGroups(
                arrayElement(splitByString('resolution:conflict:', key), 2),
                '(.+)\.git-([a-f0-9]{40}):(.*)$'
            ) AS groups
        FROM "default"."redis_json"
        WHERE startsWith(key, 'resolution')
    )
)
SELECT 
    count() AS "Resolution Groups"
FROM base_merges
